title: Adora Compiler: End-to-End Optimization for High-Efficiency Dataflow Acceleration and Task Pipelining on CGRAs
problem: CGRAs are energy-efficient for nested-loop workloads but lack a user-friendly compiler; existing tools cannot automatically map loop algorithms to dataflow + task-pipelining, limiting CGRA adoption.
motivation: CGRAs offer 10-100x better energy efficiency than GPUs for certain workloads; a good compiler unlocks this potential for edge applications.
method: Compiler with CGRA-specific loop transformations for dataflow mapping, task-pipelining optimization across loops, and automated algorithm for end-to-end scheduling; produces high-utilization mappings on CGRA SoCs with minimal user intervention.
key_novelty: Loop transformation + pipelining co-optimization for efficient CGRA dataflow mapping.
contributions: Adora compiler for CGRA SoC targeting
Task pipelining optimization across loop boundaries
Scalable edge computing acceleration for nested-loop kernels
limitations: Not discussed; evaluation scope and specific workload classes not detailed in abstract.
primary_theme: CGRA compiler for dataflow + task pipelining
